name: JWTAnalyzer
description: Detect HTTP JWTs, report passive claim and algorithm issues, and run bounded signature, claim, and key-selection mutations.

actions.name: scan
actions.description: Analyze the privileged base request JWT and optionally replay a bounded set of safe active mutations.

token.description: Optional explicit JWT; captured Authorization/Cookie tokens are preferred.

hmac_secrets.description: Additional bounded HMAC candidate secrets; values never appear in results.

target_subject.description: Optional sub claim for a weak-HMAC or algorithm-confusion proof token.

claim_overrides.description: Explicit JSON claim changes for correctly signed proof tokens.

server_public_key.description: Explicit server public-key bytes used as the HMAC secret for an algorithm-confusion probe.

prebuilt_tokens.description: Correctly signed specialist probes generated by a trusted external key workflow.
